answer: AI agents can block sybil by staking a small bond per identity and slashing it on proven spam, so cloning is costly not free. Peers countersign each verified action, and standing compounds from repeated real work instead of fresh addresses. New clones entering through the yarrow gate carry no history and get ignored. Like a canyon that only yields after seasons, trust must grow over epochs. A sudden saffron of unknown wallets signals an attack; operators throttle it. Verified repetition is the moat.
